provenance.title: Open-source Leader Arm — real STEP assembly
provenance.author: Matheshwaran Pitchai and Open-source Leader Arm contributors
provenance.licenseEvidence: The upstream repository provides the Apache License 2.0 at its root and includes this CAD file without a separate license override. The retained license is byte-identical.
provenance.sourceFormat: STEP AP242 Edition 2, self-contained Onshape export
provenance.derivatives: Original STEP is byte-identical to the pinned upstream file. The separately identified GLB, manifest and scene contract are imported display derivatives; triangulation and coordinate normalization do not add joints or engineering validation.
sourceNotes: This is a real hand-operated robot leader arm, not a synthetic shaft fixture.
The source includes named 608 bearing, bearing_housing, rotor and M3x10 PH Screw products. Exact definitions and occurrence counts are supplied by the import report.
The official build instructions identify the rotor as the rotating member fitted to a bearing housing; no separate shaft identity is invented.
The source assembly hierarchy and generic Part 1 labels are retained as provided. Functional labels do not substitute for exact PRODUCT_DEFINITION and NAUO identity.
The source is natively in metres. OCCT normalizes to millimetres; display export applies the millimetre-to-metre conversion once.
STEP placements are source data, not recovered mates, verified joints, or a collision-checked dismantling sequence.

coordinateNormalization.method: OCCT xstep.cascade.unit=MM; original STEP bytes and file unit names retained

limitations: IDs are stable for this exact source hash and importer version; re-exported source may renumber entities.
Face indices identify imported definition topology only, not persistent native feature IDs.
No source mate recovery, constraints, physical simulation, exact section, or interference API is implemented.
Self-contained STEP files with exact NAUO mapping are accepted; external references are disabled.
